手臂贴着耳朵伸直，双腿并拢伸直。

actions.muscleGroupsZh: 腹直肌（含深层腹横肌）、髋屈肌
actions.purpose: 练腹部和抬腿的力量，提升撑住身体的能力

zh: 手臂撑直，膝盖抬到胸前
肩膀往下压，别耸肩。
做得稳了，再试着两腿轮流往前伸直。

actions.purposeEn: Build your abs and leg-lifting strength while you hold yourself up.
cuesEn: Lock your arms and pull your knees to your chest
Press your shoulders down, away from your ears.
Once it feels steady, try straightening one leg forward, then the other.

commonErrors.en: Shrugging and letting the neck shorten.

cautionsEn: Stop if your wrists hurt or go numb.
Warm up your wrists before you start.

髋和大腿贴着垫子，肩膀往下放。
停住呼吸，再慢慢放下。

cautions: 腰不舒服时抬低一点，还疼就停
actions.purposeEn: Loosen your back and stretch the front of your belly.
cuesEn: Press gently through your hands and slowly lift your chest
Keep your hips and thighs on the mat and your shoulders down.
Stay and breathe, then lower slowly.

commonErrors.en: Lifting the hips off the mat.

cautionsEn: If your lower back feels uncomfortable, lift lower, and stop if it still hurts.

actions.purpose: 拉伸后腿的髋前侧和大腿前侧

zh: 上身挺直，收紧臀部把髋往前送
后脚脚背搭在矮凳上，前脚踩稳，双手叉腰。
停住不动，慢慢呼吸。
每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。

cautions: 只拉到舒服的程度，疼就放松
后膝下面垫软垫，膝盖不舒服就幅度小一点
actions.purposeEn: Stretch the front of the back leg's hip and thigh.
cuesEn: Stay tall, squeeze your glutes, and ease your hips forward
Rest the top of your back foot on the stool, front foot planted, hands on hips.
Stay still and breathe slowly.
Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

commonErrors.en: Arching your lower back instead of squeezing your glutes.

cautionsEn: Stretch only to a comfortable point, and ease off if anything hurts.
Pad under your back knee, and move less if the knee feels uncomfortable.

Stay still and breathe slowly.
Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

zh: 把上身卷起来，肩胛骨离开垫子

cuesEn: Curl up until your shoulder blades leave the mat
Keep your lower back down and reach your hands toward your knees.
Pause, then roll down slowly.

Lifting the lower back off the mat.

cautionsEn: If your neck feels uncomfortable, curl up less, and stop if it still hurts.

左右轮流弯，往上时掌心慢慢转向上。

actions.purposeEn: Build inner-thigh strength right from your chair.
cuesEn: Squeeze the yoga block hard between your knees
Sit tall, feet hip-width apart, hands on your thighs.

actions.purpose: 腿往侧面滑到最远时练大腿内侧的控制，帮助横叉

zh: 腿伸直往侧面滑出，再用大腿内侧拉回
一只脚踩滑垫，另一侧膝盖弯、臀部往后坐。

actions.purposeEn: Train inner-thigh control as your leg slides far out to the side, helping your side splits.
cuesEn: Slide the straight leg out to the side, then pull it back with your inner thigh
Put one foot on the slider, bend the other knee and sit your hips back.
Stop at a distance you can control; do not force it.

commonErrors.en: Sliding too far and losing control.
Letting the standing knee cave in.

cautionsEn: If your inner thigh or knee hurts, slide less far, and stop if it still hurts.

cautionsEn: If your stretch hurts, move less far, and stop if it still hurts.

actions.purpose: 看看髋前侧紧不紧，同时轻轻拉伸髋前侧

zh: 双手抱住一侧膝盖，另一条腿放松贴地
看伸直那条腿的大腿会不会离开地面，离开说明髋前侧偏紧。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cautions: 膝盖或髋部疼时抱得松一点，还疼就停
actions.purposeEn: Check whether the front of your hip is tight while gently stretching it.
cuesEn: Hug one knee with both hands and let the other leg rest long
Watch whether the straight thigh lifts off the floor; if it does, the front of that hip is tight.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

commonErrors.zh: 伸直的腿故意用力压地或抬起
commonErrors.en: Pressing the straight leg down or lifting it on purpose.

commonErrors.zh: 抱得太用力，腰离开地面
commonErrors.en: Pulling the knee in so hard that your lower back lifts.

cautionsEn: If your knee or hip hurts, hug less, and stop if it still hurts.

前后分腿站，后脚踮起，一只手扶椅背。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cautions: 腰疼时幅度小一点，还疼就停
actions.purposeEn: Stretch the front of your hip to ease tightness from sitting.
cuesEn: Squeeze your glutes and ease your hips forward
Stand in a split stance, back heel up, one hand on the chair.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.
cautionsEn: If your lower back hurts, move less far, and stop if it still hurts.

zh: 手抓脚踝，把脚跟拉向臀部

保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。

actions.purposeEn: Stretch the front of your thigh.
cuesEn: Hold your ankle and draw your heel toward your glutes
Stand tall on one leg holding the chair, knees side by side.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

cautionsEn: If your knee hurts, bend it less, and stop if it still hurts.

zh: 手臂举高，身体往另一侧弯，髋不动
双脚与髋同宽，另一只手放在大腿外侧。

actions.purpose: 不加重量，练脚踝把脚底往外翻的控制

zh: 小腿不动，脚底慢慢向外翻
一只手轻扶椅子，这只脚悬空。
在舒服的范围内翻到位，再慢慢回正。

commonErrors.zh: 转小腿或转髋来代替脚踝
commonErrors.en: Turning the shin or hip instead of the ankle.

cautions: 扶稳没有轮子的椅子，疼或站不稳时就停
actions.countingSemantics: 右足向外翻并回到中立计1次；中途轻停仍属于同一次主动控制，不按秒数改成静态拉伸。 本稿默认1组，每组10次，组间休息10秒；按工作/支撑侧分别计量，示范侧完成后换侧同量另计。

zh: 只在能安全站立、椅子稳定的条件下作悬空主动控制，不踩足缘承重、不强扳；不是扭伤治疗处方。

actions.purposeEn: Train control of turning the sole of your foot outward, with no added weight.
cuesEn: Keep your shin still and slowly turn your sole outward
Rest one hand lightly on a chair and lift this foot off the floor.
Turn as far as is comfortable, then come back slowly.
cautionsEn: Use a stable chair without wheels, and stop if it hurts or you feel unsteady.
